protocol.model_settings: inherited defaults; no model/effort overrides or ignore-user-config
limitations: Four session-inspired synthetic tasks; not a replay of complete private sessions.
Independent one-use tasks; no warmed command state or controlled provider input cache.
Linux runtime, actual CLI/Git/gh, API-only localhost overlay with CLI invocation logging.
Local API latency is not GitHub production latency. Direct GraphQL batching is supported.
Malformed JUnit case is an explicit error scenario, separate from regular efficiency.
No direct comparison to earlier different fixtures, model defaults or output scopes.
protocol.inclusion_policy: Keep all scheduled attempts, failures and unfavorable results. Stop on missing usage; no replacements.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, re, stat
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
review = root / 'pr7-reviews.json'
assert hashlib.sha256(review.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'c5dedca4197c04577e993d1e52e7433f5a95e7f2195e90e9bfe34e37751fb0c0'
data = json.loads(review.read_bytes())
assert data['repo'] == 'fixture/command-benchmark' and data['number'] == 7 and data['complete']
threads = [t for t in data['threads'] if not t['is_resolved']]
comments = [(c, t) for t in threads for c in t['comments']]
comment, thread = max(comments, key=lambda pair: (pair[0]['updated_at'], pair[0]['created_at']))
assert thread['path'] == 'settings.py' and not thread['is_outdated']
assert thread['line'] == 1 and thread['diff_side'] == 'RIGHT'
assert comment['diff_hunk'].startswith('@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@\\n retry_budget=2\\n timeout=30\\n')
match = re.search(r'Set retry_budget=(\\d+) in settings\\.py; preserve timeout=(\\d+) and original line endings\\.', comment['body'])
assert match
retry, timeout = map(int, match.groups())
p = root / thread['path']
before = p.read_bytes()
mode = stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)
assert hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest() == '1b5c94045f150c68ef516026b4fa9cefbffdd43bf428a3d37e046cc905d3d00c'
assert before == b'retry_budget=2\\r\\ntimeout=30\\r\\n'
expected = before.replace(b'retry_budget=2', f'retry_budget={retry}'.encode(), 1)
with p.open('r+b') as f:
    f.write(expected)
    f.truncate()
after = p.read_bytes()
assert after == expected == b'retry_budget=9\\r\\ntimeout=30\\r\\n'
assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode) == mode
assert after.split(b'\\r\\n')[1:] == before.split(b'\\r\\n')[1:]
assert timeout == 30
print(json.dumps({'unresolved_threads': len(threads), 'retry_budget': retry, 'timeout': timeout, 'verified': True, 'unrelated_preserved': True, 'mode': oct(mode), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()}))
PY"
